prompt: A small, dim kitchen at night, filmed from a fixed point in the corner near the ceiling, looking down on Brandon sitting at a wooden table with a cold mug and one hand resting beside his phone. The phone lies face up but turned away so that its screen is only a soft blur of pale light spilling on the tabletop and on his hands and jaw. His head is bowed, his eyebrows have lifted in the middle, his eyelids are wide open and his eyes are aimed down at the glowing phone. A single pendant bulb is off, so the phone is the only light, leaving the corners of the room dark. Washed-out colour, grainy night-mode texture. Thanks.
